title: Microsoft Teams: view files and conversations side by side
summary: The briefing passes: its behaviour, default and rollout dates agree with the roadmap and Microsoft's tenant notice, and searches found no documented switch for this view. The licensing section should name the general Teams licence requirement rather than leave the model unknown; no feature-specific entitlement or meter was found.
